title: Started Making Cooing Sounds
desc: Little vowel sounds and soft coos — your first attempts at conversation, and we were hanging on every syllable.
story: Seven weeks old and you found your voice — not crying, but something altogether softer and more magical. Little 'ooh' and 'aah' sounds, round and gentle, like you were testing out what your mouth could do. We cooed right back at you, and you seemed delighted. It felt like the beginning of a very long and wonderful conversation.
